existing_grounding_method_check.observed_resolution: Abbreviated PDH source sentence suggested PDPK1; actual primary title+abstract changed top candidate to PDK1. PRK citation context retained PDPK1. MST1 inspected cases rank curated STK4 without context disambiguation.
existing_grounding_method_check.suitable_role: Ranked conflict candidates for source review, with citation context and all native candidates preserved.

signature_source_fit.preferred_direction: Curated evidence grounding first, then a source-qualified curated comparator; iKiP remains a separate in-vitro signature comparator rather than default prior replacement
signature_source_fit.eligibility_rule: Published comparator requires at least five distinct measured target sites per kinase; this is not an accuracy guarantee and was not retroactively applied to the completed study.

published_comparator.correction_interpretation: Figure4-6 caption headings were reordered; no performance-result reversal stated

signature_source_fit.source_rights: iKiP CC BY-NC4.0 content and row-derived audit remain private/ignored; software MIT is separate. No NC rows or private candidate match counts are included.

study.kind: Human HCT116 stable genetic perturbation, paired total proteome/phosphoproteome
study.license: CC BY-NC4 article/supplement metadata; keep external workbooks private/untracked, separate from MIT software.

assay_limits: Small exploratory external target/signature recovery only; no confirmatory or general biological-gain claim.
Stable-clone adaptation, unspecified elapsed post-editing time, unspecified independent-clone replication, and no declared site-localization/FDR threshold remain explicit.
PIK3CA protein phosphosite response is a pathway-context endpoint, not a direct lipid activity measurement.
A downstream signature score does not establish direct catalytic substrate truth or endogenous target engagement.
Keep all three declared protein-kinase targets and abstentions; do not replace the reference on poor coverage or declare other kinases true negatives.

Final method/source/mapping/protein-adjustment/comparator/metric hashes and selected-study source exclusion must be pinned before row access or inference. This is an ordinary existing workflow gate, not a request for new broad research.
